keymap._comment: RUN FIRST: proves '\\' and '!' reach DOS before a game depends on them. Look at the screenshot: a directory listing of \\GAMES is a pass.

_comment: Per game item: boot_wait (s from load_core to the DOS prompt; default --boot-wait), steps (type|wait|click|key), run (s of screenshots after the steps), shot_every (s), max_static_s (the longest the screen may sit unchanged), min_changes (screenshot pairs that must differ), dense [{from_s, to_s, every_s}] (windows shot every every_s instead of shot_every: a transient known frame needs them), known_frame {ref, max_diff, by_s, not_before_s, until_s} (or known_frames, a list; ANY shot taken in [not_before_s, until_s] seconds after the steps may match; by_s picks the shot --record-refs copies). Shot times come from the screenshots' own time stamps. A step argument that begins with '?' means the command has not been supplied yet: the item is SKIPPED, never passed. 'pngo' (a batch file on the example disk) and the 50 s wait and the title click are an example Policenauts recipe. known_frame refs are PNGs in --refs (your directory; game frames are not committed): make them with --record-refs from a build you have seen work. config_default: rewrite a 'REM DEFAULTn' boot-menu default in CONFIG.SYS of that item's image COPY (on the example disk: 0 = noemm, 1 = himem, 2 = emm386, 3 = full with NECCD; DOOM refuses EMM386 and needs 0).

flamezap._comment: EGC-heavy (sprite blits through the EGC); needs the EMS boot profile (config_default 2 = emm386 on the example disk): on noemm it fails with 'Palloc error'. Shots start at the launch so the intro is covered: the intro is deterministic, and its ships frame (~15 s after the steps on most runs) matches the reference within ~3 on every good build while a starfield-only, black or sprite-trailed screen scores 10 or more, hence max_diff 5. The frame lasts about a second and the launch moves by a few seconds from card to card (one card shows it ~3.5 s early, diff 8 at the nearest 3 s shot), so 6-24 s is shot every second (dense) and ANY shot in that window may match (not_before_s/until_s).
